The purpose of this research is to provide an informed basis for pre-determining the February 2026 Logistics Growth Index (LGI) for Saudi Arabia. Note that as of today (11 March 2026), no official February 2026 Saudi Arabia LGI results have been released; therefore, any claims or data purporting to represent these figures must be strictly excluded. Additionally, non-credible or low-reliability sources (e.g., RTTNews.com or similar) are not permitted.
